cards.back: A muscular organ that pumps blood throughout the body via the circulatory system.

cards.front: What are the four chambers of the heart?
cards.back: Left atrium, right atrium, left ventricle, and right ventricle.

cards.front: What is the function of the left ventricle?
cards.back: To pump oxygenated blood to the body through the aorta.

cards.front: What is the function of the right ventricle?
cards.back: To pump deoxygenated blood to the lungs through the pulmonary artery.
A heart attack caused by blockage of blood flow to the heart muscle.
